object_description: angled ground plan spanned by a timber skeleton with a folded, dancing roof
design_condition: the new building aligns its presence and forecourt to the north towards the functional centre, softening the direct reference to the street and seeking an expressive appearance

positive: The authors read a structure interspersed with open spaces from the central area and develop it further
The presence and orientation of the forecourt align the building to the functional centre
An expressive appearance is sought and found for the new building
The existing barn is retained and converted into a cultural social space
A timber skeleton spans the angled ground plan
Together with the framework under the eaves this creates a folded, dancing impression
The stage space is interesting in terms of its visual presentation
Disabled access is guaranteed via the foyer
The social area and the outside part of the foyer are nicely grouped around the copper beech
The quality lies in modelling a new central area where uses interlock with various open spaces
negative: The diverse inside-outside relationships lead to a multitude of individual solutions despite the unifying principle
Large events are given greater consideration than everyday school life
The basic geometry of the stage layout does not correspond to the design brief
The stage harbours technical and acoustic risks requiring great technical resources
There are no classic side stages or separable multifunctional areas
A hard surface marks the perimeter and introduces a separation of areas that is difficult to understand
The gravel island can only solve the parking regime with additional design measures
The garage ramp is unnecessarily designed with two lanes
The western corner develops a kind of second rear side, counter to the integrative basic form
The placement of the tree rows appears awkward given the orientation of the hall to the southern open space
The structural solution leads to spans of well over 30 metres
The comparatively high proportion of glass is likely to have a negative impact on costs
More attention should be paid to summer overheating with the hard court on the southwest facade
The urban setting and the gesture promise more than the situation can achieve on closer inspection
